drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 50-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.86, creatinine 0.84-0.85, hemoglobin 13.5-13.6, platelets 259-265, sodium 138-139, wbc 9.1-9.5; vitals dbp 73-76, heart_rate 81-86, map 93-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 134-140, spo2 95-96, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.81-0.83, hemoglobin 13.6-13.7, platelets 260-266, sodium 138-139, wbc 9.6-9.7; vitals dbp 71-76, heart_rate 81-86, map 93-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 134-140, spo2 96-97, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 50-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
